function findcycle(u,   i, v) {
  color[u] = 1
  stack[++sp] = u
  for (i = 1; i <= adjcnt[u]; i++) {
    v = adj[u, i]
    if (done[v]) continue
    if (color[v] == 1) {
      # cycle from v to top of stack
      cyc = ""
      for (j = 1; j <= sp; j++) if (stack[j] == v) { start = j; break }
      for (j = start; j <= sp; j++) cyc = cyc (cyc==""?"":" ") stack[j]
      cyc = cyc " " v
      return 1
    }
    if (color[v] == 0) if (findcycle(v)) return 1
  }
  color[u] = 2
  sp--
  return 0
}
